concerns.text: FR-001 requires that only entries with experimentally measured decomposition temperatures are retained. T003 fetches NREL data but does not specify filtering for experimental T_d, leaving the FR potentially weakened.
FR-001 also applies to Materials Project data; T004 fetches data but lacks explicit filtering for experimental T_d, risking inclusion of calculated or missing values.

SC-006 mandates verification that every predictor and outcome variable listed in the spec is present in the source datasets. No task explicitly checks for the presence of all required columns (e.g., T_d_uncertainty, instrument_model) before downstream processing.
Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) requires a task that validates citation title‑token overlap. No task implements this verification, violating the constitution.
Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) demands that random seeds be pinned in code. T027 runs the pipeline but does not set or record a fixed seed, breaching the reproducibility requirement.

The stratified CV pre‑flight check aborts if any family is missing from a fold, which effectively narrows the dataset to only families present in every fold. This retroactive narrowing can weaken FR‑004’s intent to evaluate on the full dataset unless the spec explicitly allows such aborts.
